name: TX-33
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 18 points, among the safest blue seats in Texas
Colin Allred has raised $7.4 million and brings statewide name recognition from his 2024 Senate run
Prediction markets price the Democratic nominee around 97% to win
Open seat after Crockett's retirement removes the incumbency cushion but not the district's partisan edge
model.rationale: The district's D+18 lean, Colin Allred's dominant fundraising and name recognition, and prediction markets pricing Democrats near 97% all point the same direction despite Crockett's retirement. The open-seat dynamic trims the margin slightly from pure fundamentals but leaves the seat well out of reach for a Republican with no reported fundraising.
model.watch: A sharply low-turnout election, primary fallout, or an unexpected scandal involving Allred could tighten a race that fundamentals otherwise make lopsided.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Jasmine Crockett (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Texas's 33rd District, anchored in Dallas, leans Democratic by 18 points, making it one of the safest Democratic seats in the state. Jasmine Crockett's retirement to run for Senate opens the seat, but Democrats have fielded a strong replacement in Colin Allred, a former congressman and 2024 Senate nominee who has raised more than $7.4 million. Republican Patrick Gillespie shows no reported fundraising or outside support in the available data.

With no public polls in the race, the outlook rests on district fundamentals and candidate resources. Both point the same way: the heavy Democratic lean, Allred's name recognition from his statewide run, and prediction markets pricing the Democratic nominee around 97% to win. The open seat removes the comfort of incumbency but is unlikely to overcome the district's partisan margins, leaving low turnout or unforeseen developments as the main residual risks.
